about: Silberstein & Miklos, P.C. is a personal injury firm with six offices across the New York area: Garden City and Hauppauge on Long Island, Brooklyn, Forest Hills, the Bronx and Manhattan.
The firm states that there is no fee unless it wins and that its initial advice is free. It publishes a 24-hour intake line, hospital and home visits, and service in English and Spanish.

subs.label: Website trust & experience

subs.label: Search authority
subs.evidence: DR 56 → 99th pct of 76-firm cohort (median 28) 3/3 · 1,776 referring domains, 97th pct 2/2 · 481 organic keywords / 2,163 visits·mo, 59th pct 1/2 · brand demand 0/1 (pending)

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 6 operational Google Business Profile listings · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned

subs.label: Content, E-E-A-T & schema
subs.evidence: JSON-LD detected 1/1 · cited in AI answers: 83 citations / 46 pages 1/1 · not assessed on any firm yet, so content depth and earned media leave the scale (3 pts)
